newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil posts net dlr inflows of $3.262 bln in Dec.
newsitem.headline: Brazil posts net dlr inflows of $3.262 bln in Dec.

text.p: Brazil's commercial and financial foreign exchange transactions showed a preliminary surplus of $3.262 billion in December in the forex commercial market, against a $2.544 billion surplus in November, bankers said.
For the whole of 1996, net dollar inflows in the forex commercial market totalled a preliminary $25.208 billion, against $13.652 billion in 1995, they said.
Financial buy deals totalled $9.894 billion in December, according to Central Bank data supplied to banks. Financial sell operations amounted to $6.877 billion last month.
Dealers said December contracted exports were $4.487 billion against $4.242 billion in import operations.
